description: Check from the internet whether TCP ports of a public host are open, closed or filtered. Use to verify firewall / security group rules, or to find out why a service works locally but is unreachable from outside. Only public addresses are accepted; this does not test the application behind the port (use check_http or check_tls for that).

host.description: Public hostname or IP address, e.g. example.com or 203.0.113.10

name: check_port

error.description: Error code when ok is false

ok.description: false when the check could not run (see error / message)

title: Port reachability from the internet
